strengths: Solid knee bend and wide, balanced base when engaged in live kitchen exchanges (evident in Rally 2 at 12.4s and Rally 6 at 82.5s).
Compact stroke mechanics on forehand dinks without unnecessary excessive backswing.

top_priority_fix.issue: Dropping the paddle to the hip and standing upright between balls at the NVZ.
top_priority_fix.why_it_matters: At the non-volley zone, balls arrive in fractions of a second; dangling the paddle at your side leaves you vulnerable to speed-ups and forces rushed, lifting contacts.
top_priority_fix.evidence: In Rally 1 (06.46s–08.47s) and between active exchanges (37.50s, 63.48s, and 84.46s), your paddle arm straightens down by your thigh with an upright posture rather than maintaining a ready chest-level paddle carriage.

secondary_observations.issue: Casual court entry and delayed split-step recovery.
secondary_observations.evidence: At 28.49s, running onto the court late and upright as the ball crosses the net rather than pre-setting a balanced split step.

drill_recommendation.name: Rapid-Fire NVZ Reset & Reload
drill_recommendation.target: Keep paddle tip above wrist and pointed forward at chest height immediately following each contact.
drill_recommendation.reps_duration: 4 rounds of 3-minute continuous unattackable dinking with a partner alternating speed-ups.
